verdict.rationale: ImageMagick's own docs claim a 'scripting-first design for mass batch jobs', which counts as first-party batch capability. The evidence never shows a single-run folder or file-list conversion command, and never shows per-file result reporting. The community bash-script loop over thousands of images is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. Missing for 10: a documented multi-file/folder conversion invocation in one run, per-file success/failure results, and independent hands-on corroboration of native batch conversion.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can convert a whole folder or list of files in one run, with per-file results

citations.quote: CLI & Automation Scripting-first design for mass batch jobs.
